selection: User selected same major and provider at least consumer, preserving legacy behavior, on 2026-09-09
version_grammar: Exactly three dot-separated canonical nonnegative decimal components, each 1 to 64 ASCII digits; leading zeroes are forbidden except the component zero itself. No ranges, prereleases, build metadata, whitespace or coercion.
comparison: Compare numeric major, minor and patch lexicographically without floating-point conversion. Zero-major versions follow the same explicitly selected policy; no additional semantics are inferred.
backward: Major components must match and the provider tuple must be greater than or equal to the consumer tuple.
exact: All three components must match exactly.
invalid_inputs: Malformed or unsupported policy objects throw an Interface policy diagnostic. Invalid consumer versions return false without invoking coercion hooks or getters.
data_boundary: Policy is a closed ordinary data object. Reject accessors, hidden or symbol properties, arrays and custom prototypes; return an owned frozen copy. Arbitrary Proxy trap isolation is not claimed.
generation: Emit a frozen descriptor and pure standalone TypeScript compatibility function without application imports, transport, file writes, class construction or a runtime policy interpreter.
legacy: Existing integer-version CLI contracts, same-major factory fixtures, source selections and defaults remain unchanged. Migration must supply an explicit new three-part version; no integer-to-version conversion is inferred.
claim_ceiling: Version eligibility only. Does not prove request/result shape compatibility, execute an Operation or Query, generate a transport, admit a profile, or complete Interface/CLI generation.
